atoms.b: When water is ((++heated cooled)) by the Sun, it turns into a ((++gas solid)) called water vapour. This process is called evaporation.

instruction.text: Which direction is the water vapour moving in?

atoms.b: The water vapour ((++rises falls)) into the sky and gets cooler. It turns back into a ((++liquid gas)) and forms clouds. This process is called condensation.
